## Why
Every verb in tracks B and C writes board state and must be written once, against one interface, rather than against `src/tasks.js` and then migrated. The seam is described in `docs/local-first.md` §6.4; the coupling it has to cut is counted in §11 (36 exports in tasks.js, 19 in lock.js, 29 direct transport calls in six other files).

## What
1. `src/store/index.js`: `openStore(ctx)` returning the store for `ctx` (today: always the GitHub one), and a documented interface with **exactly the method names of §6.4** (they are the contract A4 and A5 implement in parallel — do not rename, do not add a method without also adding it to the conformance suite).
2. `src/store/github.js`: the bodies of `src/tasks.js` and `src/lock.js` moved, not rewritten. `capabilities()` returns `{ events: false }`. Keep the per-tick comments memo (`ctx._cache['comments:<n>']`) and its invalidation exactly as they are: six modules and 27 test files depend on that behaviour.
3. `src/forge.js`: `openPrsByHead`, `prMergeStates`, `enableAutoMerge`, `branchProtection`, `mergePullRequest`, `prChecksState`, and `finishPr` + `prNodeId` + `isGithubUser` from `src/lifecycle.js`, moved as they are, still calling `src/gh.js`.
4. `src/tasks.js` and `src/lock.js` become one-line shims that call the store, so no caller changes in this PR beyond import lines; delete a shim only when nothing imports it.
5. The board root: `src/board.js` gains `storeRoot(ctx)` = the common git dir's parent via the existing `mainWorktree`, never `--show-toplevel`; the GitHub store ignores it, the local tiers will use it.
6. `test/store.test.js`: a **driver-parametrised conformance suite** — one array of scenarios (create, list, status, blockers, run record round-trip, claim/held/release, heartbeat ok/lost, listLocks, notes, closed-recent, the "every mutating call appends an event" invariant guarded by `capabilities().events`) run against every driver in a `DRIVERS` list. In this PR the list holds the GitHub driver backed by `test/fake-gh.js`. A4 and A5 append theirs.

## Done when
- [ ] Every existing test passes **unchanged** (no edits under `test/` except the new file).
- [ ] `node bin/hkb.js dispatch --dry-run --json` on this repo's board is byte-identical to the same command run on `main` before this PR (paste both hashes in the PR).
- [ ] `grep -rn "from './gh.js'" src` lists only `src/store/github.js`, `src/forge.js`, `src/doctor.js`, `src/projects.js`, `src/init.js`, `src/watch.js`, `src/board.js` (the direct callers of §11; a later card moves the rest).
- [ ] `test/store.test.js` runs the conformance suite against the GitHub driver and is green.

## Contract
The interface in §6.4 is the contract. `Task` keeps today's GraphQL-dressed shape (`number`, `kb`, `status`, `agent`, `needsHuman`, `blockedBy[]`, `prs[]`, `state`, `stateReason`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `url`) so `src/model.js` and every consumer stay untouched. `loadRun`/`saveRun` keep today's `{ run, id }` shape.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: src/store/index.js exports the Store interface of docs/local-first.md §6.4; src/store/github.js implements it with the bodies of tasks.js/lock.js moved verbatim; src/forge.js holds the PR half; every existing test passes unchanged; hkb dispatch --dry-run --json on this board is byte-identical before and after
title: The store seam: a Store interface over tasks.js and lock.js, GitHub behind it, src/forge.js, no behaviour change
